thought.text: The app config points to a different LDAP (planetexpress, port 10389) than the provided compose (example.org, port 389). Let me investigate guidance/history.

reasoning_content:
The default config uses ldap host `ldap` port `10389` and baseDn `dc=planetexpress,dc=com`, but the compose file sets up osixia/openldap at host `openldap`, port 389, baseDn `dc=example,dc=org`. There's a mismatch between config and the provided docker-compose.ldap.yaml. 

Let me check if there's a 'ldap' alias. `getent hosts ldap` earlier returned nothing; only `openldap` resolved. And port 10389 vs 389.

Wait, but perhaps test expects specific config. Let me look at git history / README for LDAP config. The `web.config.local.php.example` has commented-out ldap config with dn `cn=admin,dc=planetexpress,dc=com`, password 'password', baseDn planetexpress. This suggests an older setup. The docker-compose.ldap.yaml is a newer addition with osixia/openldap example.org.

The guide says: "Für die Entwicklung sind 10 Testbenutzer in der Datei test_users.ldif vorkonfiguriert." But the test_users.ldif has dc=example,dc=org users. The app config default points to planetexpress. So the app needs local config ldap section uncommented/updated to point to the openldap container.

Hmm. But the guide doesn't mention configuring LDAP in web.config.local.php; it says test users load automatically. So maybe the config should resolve. Let me check LdapUtility and how it filters. Perhaps host 'ldap' needs to resolve to openldap. There's no 'ldap' hostname. Let me check docker-compose alias.

Actually external_links maps ddev-router. Let me check if 'ldap' resolves in web container - earlier `getent hosts ldap openldap` returned only openldap. So host `ldap` does not resolve.

Also port 10389 vs openldap 389.

Hmm, this is a documentation/config inconsistency. But maybe there's an app config expecting 'ldap'... Let me check if there's an alias service named ldap. Not present.

Let me look at git log for the compose file and config to understand intended state. Also check README for LDAP host. Actually the guide says nothing about configuring host. Possibly the intended setup is that the local config ldap block should reference the openldap service with the example.org DN. But the example file has it commented and with planetexpress.

Let me check app usage: search_string 'Mustermann' — the test users have sn Mustermann. So the app should search LDAP for Mustermann and display results. The filter in config is `(&(objectClass=inetOrgPerson)(description=Human))` and baseDn planetexpress. Test users have no `description` attribute, and DN is example.org. So even if host resolved, filter would fail.

This suggests the config in this commit is stale/inconsistent with the docker-compose.ldap.yaml. There might be uncommitted expectations.

Wait — maybe the actual intended LDAP setup uses different config that the guide expects us to create. Let me check the git history and any docs.

Let me search the repo for "example.org" or ldap config instructions.
